summary: Iter 41 - Verified cair-tanggal routing (online Selesai with cair.tanggal counts in cair month, not order month) and new /api/reports/cash/day detail endpoint. UI dialog (CashDayDialog) opens from CashDailyTable row click, shows per-kind items with correct net total, closes on Escape.
critical_code_review_comments: report_cash_day doesn't validate date format - a malformed date like 'abc' falls back to cash_events('ab') and returns a non-empty list. Minor: add YYYY-MM-DD regex validation (same for /reports/cash/daily period).
cash_events() iterates all ecommerce_sales (status Selesai) across all time then filters by prefix in Python; for scale, add an index-friendly $or query on either cair.tanggal or created_at prefix.

CASH_KINDS ordering in cash_day: 'toko' before 'online' but TikTok Shop cair example shows single online kind - ordering only matters when multiple kinds present on same day; verified correct in test.
seed_data_creation: Test period 2098-04 (order month) + 2098-05 (cair month): 1 Selesai sale with cair.tanggal=2098-05-07 cair.nominal=900000 (created 2098-04-28), 1 Selesai sale without cair (created 2098-04-28), plus POS 250k, loan 2M, expense 150k, purchase 400k all on 2098-05-07. All tagged test_mark=TEST_ITER41_* and cleaned up in fixture teardown.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend /api/reports/cash/day?date=YYYY-MM-DD returns {date, items:[{kind,amount,title,desc,info,date}]} sorted by CASH_KINDS order with zero-amount filtered and bruto/fee stripped. Per-kind sums == daily row for same date. Online Selesai with cair.tanggal correctly routes to cair month (not created_at month); without cair, uses created_at. UI: data-testids cash-day-dialog, cash-day-item-{i}, cash-day-net all present; dialog closes on Escape. Verified against real DB TikTok Shop sale (2026-10-11 cair, Rp 251.200). CashDayDialog is in /app/frontend/src/components/CashDayDialog.jsx.
